title: Callbacks and Higher-Order Methods knowledge check

options: Replace all built-in features with a third-party framework regardless of the task.
Skip tests because a short example ran once.
Use Callbacks and Higher-Order Methods deliberately: state the expected behavior, apply it in a small example, and verify a boundary case.
